name: roll kneeling upper back rotation
description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the upper back. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Kneel beside the roller and place one hand on it.
Place the roller under the upper back and let your body weight settle onto it.
Slide the roller forward as you rotate your chest open.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.
